title: Bite Maker AK Manga Ends
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Miwako Sugiyama 's Bite Maker: AK (Area Kanazawa) manga announced on Saturday that the manga will end on Shogakukan 's Biccomi platform on May 30. The series launched on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app in May 2023.

title: Kakao Ent. Opens Submissions for New Drama Webtoon Series
content: Kakao Entertainment announced on May 13 that it will accept submissions for new drama-genre webtoons from May 27 through June 10, as part of its ongoing effort to expand its content pipeline.
